purpose: Phase 0 frozen pre-change baseline for the procedural puppet upgrade (master plan §4). Read-only characterization; no puppet code changed.

timeline.cyclic: 26-frame gait cycle; the 94-frame clip itself is NOT an exact loop

failedChecks: limb segment length variation within documented tolerance (max/min <= 2)

segmentLengthOrigin.note: Three levels, measured separately: rawMeasuredKeys (7 hand-measured poses per leg, read read-only from keys.ts) -> storedTrack (26-sample LEG_CYCLE after build-time Catmull-Rom) -> interpolatedFrames (all 94). interpolationOvershoot = interpolated max / stored max. Diagnostic only — the tolerance above and the puppet itself are unchanged.

puppet.objective: diagnostic only — objective is editability + plausible motion, NOT pixel equality

fidelity.note: see reports/baseline/fidelity-all-frames.json for the full structure

measuredNow.note: Recomputed read-only from keys.ts joint math at all 94 frames; must agree with the committed Test I segment stats.

near.candidateRule: lowest point within 12px of foot max reach AND |ankle vx| <= 25 px/frame — UNVERIFIED candidates for Phase 2 review
near.proximityRule: lowest point within 12px of foot max reach (velocity NOT constrained) — label `uncertain` until Phase 2 review

far.candidateRule: lowest point within 12px of foot max reach AND |ankle vx| <= 25 px/frame — UNVERIFIED candidates for Phase 2 review
far.proximityRule: lowest point within 12px of foot max reach (velocity NOT constrained) — label `uncertain` until Phase 2 review

geometry.foot: filled wedge along ankle->toe, half-width 15, heel extension 24 (stretchy: ankle->toe length varies 1.849x)
geometry.backpack: flat rounded rect 140x185 at (818, headY+222), rotate -12, single strap line
geometry.torso: single bezier quad between shoulder and hip anchors
geometry.drawOrder: shadow -> far leg -> far arm -> scarf tail -> backpack+strap -> torso+neck -> near leg -> scarf knot -> head -> near arm

knownPreExistingDefect.check: Test I limb segment length max/min <= 2.0
knownPreExistingDefect.classification: PRE-EXISTING (raw keys 1.958x -> Catmull-Rom stored track 2.891x -> interpolation overshoot <=1.192x). Phase 1 replaces this ratio gate with per-bone configured-length error.

contactCharacterization.finding: The strict candidate rule (near-ground AND |ankle vx| <= 25 px/frame) matches ZERO frames for both feet: the unconstrained track has no unambiguous stance. At the deepest ground-proximity frames the ankle still moves 27-74 px/frame horizontally — measured foot slip, the defect Phase 2 must fix.
contactCharacterization.proximityWindows: near foot ~frames 17-19/43-45/69-71; far foot ~frames 4-6/30-32/56-58/82-84 (13-frame alternation). All labelled UNCERTAIN candidates for Phase 2 manual review, not verified stance.
